description:
Returns one custom field of this company, archived or not, with the options that apply to the query: the common ones plus, with `customer_id`, those of that customer. Archived options are left out unless `include_archived=true`. A field with `suggest_values: false` carries no options; list them with `GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key}/options`.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key} (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

CustomFieldKey.description: Identifier of the custom field within the company, chosen when the field is created: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. It never changes. BeeL. gives it no meaning of its own.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

customer_id.description: Adds the options of this customer to the common ones. A value that names no customer of this company is not an error: only the common options come back.

key.description: Key of the custom field: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. A key outside that format answers `422`.

name: beel_get_custom_field
